<h1>Swing</h1>

## Purpose

Delay every **second step** of a sequencer's pattern by a fraction of one
step to produce shuffle. Counted as the trig view labels them, the delayed
steps are the even-numbered ones (2, 4, 6 …). Each sequencer has a coarse
row-selected level (row 1 = straight, row 8 = half a step) plus a fine offset
that interpolates toward the next coarse level. Which steps swing is one
16-step pattern shared by every sequencer; no control on the hardware or in
the webapp edits it.

## Interaction

The grid shows each sequencer's current swing level; column = sequencer
(LHS cols 1–7 → sequencers 1–7, RHS cols 1–7 → sequencers 9–15), row = coarse level.
A single pad lights at the level's height rather than a bar, and its
colour reports the fine offset: spring green at fine 0, then paler blues
as the fine knob climbs. Column 8 of each LP stays dark, because it
would land on the LC page sequencers, which have no swing.

Pressing a pad also aims the fine knob at that sequencer. The knob is
bottom-row knob 8 on your own LaunchControl, whichever user template you
are on, and its LED ring shows the fine value it is about to change. On
entering the view it aims at the last sequencer you were on, and if
there isn't one it does nothing until you press a pad.

## Shortcuts

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press | LP grid | Set the pressed column's sequencer to the pressed row's coarse swing level, and aim the fine knob at it | none |
| Turn knob | LC bottom-row knob 8 | Fine offset 0–127 for the aimed sequencer, interpolating toward the next coarse level | any |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press | LP grid | **Reset that slot**: level → row 1 (straight), fine → 0 | shift+mute |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press | LP grid | **Randomise that slot**: level → uniform random across rows 1–8 (fine untouched) | shift+solo |
| SHIFT + MUTE / SOLO | Row mutes | No-op on this view | any |
